This week Gods love was made known through Praying and encouraging. Out of the 8 people encountered,  2 were young children.  One of the encounters really  stood out today. As we (Laneer Peele and myself) walked and prayed in the Glen Dale community, one of the ladies we make a point to check on when we are in the area, had surgery last week. As she began telling us about the surgery she told us about knots that had formed in different  areas of her stomach, immediately we laid hands on her and began to pray for a miracle.  After the prayer she mentioned the knots were itching, then she went on to say the doctor said when they start to itch they are healing!!! Prior to the prayer she hadn’t mentioned any itching.  We rejoiced at what God was doing and told her we would be waiting for the testimony of her full healing!
Spoke with a friend who’s been hurt by the Catholic Church, regarding current events and lead him into a conversation about the gospel. Pointed him back to Jesus and a mindset of unity/love.

ONE of the 33 people I shared the gospel with was with a close relative of mine. Our relationship was always rocky but got worse when our “Great Relative” died last year. After all the chaos that had happened within the last few weeks, i gathered the courage to tell them that I was sorry, I forgave them, and that I still loved them. But I also said that Jesus loved them more and that regardless of their past mistakes and choices in their lives, they are never far from His mercy and grace and love. I haven heard back from them and I’m not sure if I’ll ever speak to them again, but at least I know that I left them with the message of everlasting life, love, and peace, if they choose to take it.

Hosted Bible study with group of international teachers and studied “What is God’s Will?” (John 6:40 and John 17:3), then exploring other verses on how to do God’s will (John 5:17,19-20, Phil 2:5-8, John 15:5)

I am currently in a class for a DUI I received 3 years ago, at the height of my drinking. (I’m 3 months sober now). This past Tuesday I shared my story of sobriety and how God and Reimage Church were, and still are, my saving grace of sobriety. This is part of what I said to them “On Sunday July 20th of this year I started severely bleeding internally from damage I had done to my body by drinking heavily for years, and I had to have emergency surgery. I received prayers from dozens of people I didn’t even know from multiple prayer groups/churches, and believe those prayers and the grace of god saved me. The next day I started my sobriety journey. My doctors and family encouraged me to go to AA, but I had done that before and did not like the atmosphere. Instead I prayed about it. The next Sunday July 27th, I was compelled to pray with one of the leaders when the song “slow me down” was playing. I was greeted by Karen who listened to my prayer request and prayed with me. She has been someone Ive been thankful for since we met because it felt like she opened a doorway of hope into my life. Since that day my faith has grown stronger, I’ve met more people at church who still pray for me and check on me, and my sobriety has been reinforced by the strength I’ve gained through Reimage. I attribute my ability to stay sober and the healing of my body to God and the people I’ve met through Reimage.” I told the class more about my battle with alcohol before I mentioned God and my church saving my life and my future. But while I was sharing and after, I was thanked by some who may have been going down the same road I had been on and many people started open conversations about their experiences with faith. I believe it was a blessing to have been the one to start that conversation and to share how AA isn’t for everyone and maybe the best way to battle their demons is by putting God and church in their lives.

I had the opportunity to pray over and speak to a group of mothers and that are struggling with unplanned pregnancies along with their peer leaders.  After sharing Gods desire for them I was able to share one in one and encourage them.  Evening after sharing with these ladies there was one that stood out. I was able to minister to my daughter again.  This was a blessing because she listened without pushback!  I know God is still working in her I can’t wait until the day she fully gives her life to Christ

Gospel response - My son, Bradley Atkinson

Multiple Spiritual Conversations with Bradley. He has had some health challenges and we talk about how God is still in control and He has a plan for Bradley’s life. Driving home from the hospital, we were talking about praying and being covered by prayer. I asked him to look up the Prayer of Salvation and tell me what it meant to him. We discussed his response and I asked him if he wanted say it with me and he said “yes”.

Bradley has said the prayer before with my wife (Tamara). This time (at 20 years old) he said he understood what he was saying and doing.

Please keep him covered in prayer and pray for us as we continue to disciple him.

Met one of my neighbors from another building. I think he may be Catholic (even wore a necklace with a Cross, depicting Jesus on the Cross). Talked about Jesus Christ, Salvation, God’s grace, and even had prayer.

Shared how the Lord will continually work in and thru you and that salvation is an event and the process  is happening til the day you transition  from the earth    -I told her it is the Spirit of God that changes you from the inside. He will never leave or forsake you even though sometimes it may feel like you are on your own that’s just a trick of the enemy. It’s identity theft.  The work is base on Jesus and what He has already done . We have to believe submit and obey.  It’s ok that you don’t get it right He will Love you any way because He already loved you when we’re an enemy to Him. Stay with Him -He will give you a special joy . Remember it’s is a process of Him working on your mindset . He wants us to be innocent conscience not sin conscience.

S-share. I shared my story and how Jesus changed me with Theresa,  a nurse, this morning while running. I noticed she was walking wearing ASICS shoes like me, I said, “nice shoes as I ran went by her on the boardwalk”. She responded, “I am going to wear them for over 150 miles in Portugal. I said, “you mean the St James Walk”? She said “yes”. She has lost 90 pounds preparing for this adventure and plans to lose 60 more. I said, “my daughter is a nurse too.” I shared my story and the gospel. She responded by saying, “ I have been contemplating Jesus , you must have been sent by God”.  The St James walk takes 13 days, I encouraged Theresa that many people walk the St James way in prayer.

I spoke with a lady at the bank. She started sharing with me her Prodigal daughter story, and the sweet relationship she has with her Dad, as I shared with her my dad story. I attempted to invite her to our Service, she then shared that she’s a member of Elevation Church.

I must admit that he interrupted my schedule, but I heard that one-liner from one of your sermons: "Can God interrupt your schedule?"  So I will add him to my list of scriptures.  At least I have permission now...not that I really needed it.  I sent him  Romans 2:4. THE END
